5 The algorithm allows a number to be entered. It then calculates and outputs the next number in
the mathematical series.
Fib 1
Prev2 0
Prev1 1
INPUT Number
IF Number = 0
THEN Fib 0
ENDIF
WHILE Number > 2
Fib Prev2 + Prev1
Prev2 Prev1
Prev1 Fib
Number Number - 1
ENDWHILE
OUTPUT Fib
